**Pages → App Router**
- `_app.js` + `_document.js` → `app/layout.tsx` — html/body shell, `AppProvider`, nav/footer, `metadata` export for description/favicon, font links

- `404.js` → `app/not-found.tsx`, `_error.js` (`getInitialProps`) → `app/error.tsx` client boundary with `error`/`reset`
- `pages/api/posts/*` → `app/api/posts/route.ts` + `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` route handlers (`NextResponse.json`, async `params: Promise<...>`, automatic 405 for unexported methods)
- `useRouter` from `next/router` → `next/navigation` in new client components (`NavigateButton`, `BackButton`); `AppProvider` → `'use client'` TSX with typed context; shared `Post`/`Comment` types in `lib/types.ts`
